simple and cheap meal ideas: soft tofu topped with a sauce (i prefer vegan mushroom oyster sauce) microwaved for 5 minutes. top w fried garlic, ginger, and/or green onions if ur feeling extra fancy
pasta + canned chickpeas, drained + vegan mayo or pesto
add tvp crumbles to vegan ramen. make sure it's the small kind so it can cook thoroughly
other random tips: carmelize onions and fry garlic in big batches and keep for later. they can be added to roasted veggies, stir fry, pan fried tofu, soups, even plain canned beans or microwave vegetables
tofu keeps its shape better in soups and stews if it's either frozen or deep fried first
add a dash of baking soda when soaking dried beans so they cook faster
canned jackfruit can be shredded and added to seitan recipes for a hacky way of adding some flaky texture if ur like me and too lazy to knead it as long as most recipes suggest
